package.name: mower_telemetry_recorder
package.description: Records pose, GPS, WLAN, IMU and selected sensor values at 4 Hz while mower_logic is in MOWING / PAUSED. One JSONL file per mowing session plus an index. Exposes telemetry.list_sessions and telemetry.get_session RPC methods so the openmower-app heatmap page can render the recorded samples on top of the map.
